$comment: obs-plugintemplate-style build spec for Parallaxa. obsSmoke lists the official OBS builds release/obs-smoke.ps1 loads the built DLL into (import check + headless libobs load). Read by .github/workflows/ci.yml, release.yml and release/package.ps1 (-Ci). Headers are pinned to the OLDEST supported OBS (32.0.0); the x64 import libraries are generated from the official OBS 32.0.0 Windows build (bin/64bit/{obs,obs-frontend-api,w32-pthreads}.dll) by tools/make-implibs.ps1. Never build against newer headers: that sets a newer API version in the module and OBS 32.x refuses it (MODULE_INCOMPATIBLE_VER).
name: parallaxa
author: Parallaxa Labs

obs-studio.label: OBS headers (sparse clone of the tag)
